title: Nonblank entries in the compared range
statement: Let $u,v$ be Boolean words and let $j<\max(|u|,|v|)$. At least one of the entries of $u$ and $v$ at index $j$ exists.
replaced:
For words $u, v$ and an index $j < \max(\abs{u}, \abs{v})$, it is not the
case that both the $j$-th entry of $u$ and the $j$-th entry of $v$ are
missing.
